title: A Sharper Certified Lower Bound for Erdos' Minimum-Overlap Problem
description:
Proof note, dual certificate and two independent interval-arithmetic verifiers for the computer-assisted lower bound c_E > 0.380557 for Erdős' minimum-overlap constant, improving the previously certified c_E > 0.38055470.

The Parseval energy inequality used here is not new; it is already present in White's Fourier-analytic approach. The contribution is the hybrid certificate: White's global Parseval energy row is inserted into Price's mean-conditioned dual-certificate framework, which allows the two binding central mean bins (85 and 86) to be improved. All other bins are Price's, reused unchanged.

The center certificate is checked by two independent software implementations: a 45-digit mpmath.iv checker and a standalone MPFR/C checker that shares no interval library, uses no root finder, and is bit-deterministic. This is not an external third-party audit; independent reproduction by another researcher is invited and had not yet occurred at the time of this deposit. The optimizer that discovered the certificate is not part of the trusted proof path.

Licensing scope. The MIT license covers only material authored for this repository. The vendor/price/ directory is a byte-for-byte redistribution of the certificate directory of Liam Price's public repository Leeham06972452/erdos-36-lower-bound at commit 6bc610e, included for provenance so that the noncentral bins can be re-verified against exactly the bytes that were used.
